title: Add the GPL license text and record the licensing decision for the Swift app
description:
The workspace is `GPL-2.0-or-later` (`Cargo.toml:8`, `analysis/pyproject.toml:5`, `README.md`) and statically links the vendored GPL Rubber Band submodule, but there is no `LICENSE` or `COPYING` file. The Amplify-deployed wasm binary is a distribution and needs a way for users to obtain corresponding source. Rubber Band is also sold under a commercial licence; if the planned Swift app (README status line) targets the App Store, GPL-2 conflicts with the App Store terms.

Done when: `LICENSE` holds the GPL-2.0-or-later text, the README links it and to the source for the deployed build, and a note in `design/` records the licensing plan for the Swift app (GPL distribution outside the store, a commercial Rubber Band licence, or a different stretcher).
